subject: general
question: Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite to the face showing '3'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfdc89ce0d3310c932f71f3fb20266aee318538a8064adc9e0b7f452489ec0f3.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a90d106e94d3aa653b009e53229900a12c5473eaf736973276627ba4a81bfa5.png] 

As 2 and 1 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 6 and 5 are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f131d5561441190ac108509f18abf52ced7f911bd03804c10efdd928dcc2baf4.png] 

As 5 and 2 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 1 and 4 are opposite to each other.

Remaining faces 2 and 3 will be opposite to each other.

Hence, '**2**' is the correct answer.
